name: Jorgarr
description: Few charts agree on Jorgarr, whose primary casts a supergiant glare across the local dark. Its worlds formed late from enriched debris, and their crusts still carry the ratio of that violent birth. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

stars.name: Waking Choir
stars.description: A supergiant of 14.45 solar masses, short-lived against the dark. It sheds mass in great slow gusts that feed the local nebula. Its wind shapes every orbit in the system, and the weather follows it.

stars.name: Kind Hearth
stars.description: A brown-dwarf of 0.0423 solar masses, cool and dim against the dark. It radiates leftover formation heat, cooling a fraction each century. Its wind shapes every orbit in the system, and the weather follows it.

planets.name: The Cinder vast
planets.description: Dune seas bury everything but the oldest basalt spires. The wind never stops, and the sand sings at dusk through the canyons. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

moons.name: Calm Flint III
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

moons.name: Tide Pumice III
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

moons.name: Shallow Pumice V
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

dwarfPlanets.name: Meridian Outer 30
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

asteroids.name: Scree 773
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

asteroids.name: Flint 295
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

belts.name: Storm Band
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.

belts.name: Quartz Trojans
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.

comets.name: Grey Needle
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
